blurb: Guests float a 6-mile stretch of the James River, starting with a shuttle ride upstream and ending back at the campground. Rentals include kayaks, canoes, rafts, tubes, and paddleboards with life jackets and paddles provided except for tubes and shuttle-only. Camping options include tent sites and RV sites with hookups, plus a riverside cabin operated by a partner.
